notes.subject: שלמים
notes.rationale: 'Complete / strongpela olgeta' o 'ol i sindaun kwait' (Targum) — ol birua bilong Juda i stap kwait na planti.

notes.subject: נגזו ועבר
notes.rationale: Hu i katim ol, na hu i go pas — Yahwe, o birua bilong Juda? Tok i no tok klia; ol translators i no wankain.

notes.subject: ⟨moa⟩ tupela hap
notes.rationale: Bihain long 'mi painim yu pen moa' — Tok Pisin i nidim 'moa' long kalends bilong 'no moa', Hibru i gat לא עוד tasol.

notes.subject: long Juda
notes.rationale: Bihain-ap ves i go direk long Juda (o Nainiva long fes hap): 'mi painim yu pen... mi no bai painim yu pen moa' — tok bilong komfot.

translation: Olsem Yahwe i tok: Sapos ol i strongpela olgeta, na olsem tu planti, olsem tu ol bai katim ol i go, na em bai go pas. Na mi painim yu pen, tasol mi no bai painim yu pen moa.

tokens.gloss: ol bai katim ol i go
